explanation: It was never about polar bears. Greek arktos also named the Great Bear, the constellation that circles the northern sky. Antarctic means opposite the Arctic.

claims.text: 'Arctic' comes from Greek arktikos, 'of the bear', from arktos, 'bear'.
'Arctic' does not come from Greek words for seal, wolf or whale.
The bear in 'Arctic' is the Great Bear constellation (Ursa Major) of the northern sky, not the polar bear.
